kits.description: Bridge: flat beam, arched (ribs) or rope-sag span with railings and end posts.
Ceiling piece (closed solid): flat slab, coffered, dome or beamed; bottom at y=0.
Column: round/square shaft, base, capital; 'organic' = smooth flared trunk (molded interiors).
Corridor interior shell (one-sided, open ends): rect/rounded/round/arch section, straight or curved.
Door: frame + hinged leaf node (kit_door_leaf, pivot at the hinge); rect/arch/oval/hatch/gothic.

segments.description: curve segments of round/oval openings (low-poly variants for room budgets)

kits.description: Floor slab (closed solid), bottom at y=0, walkable top at y=thickness.
Exterior building (closed solids): rect cottage / round dome shelter / oval hut; roof types; door, lit windows, chimney, beams.
Pier/jetty: piles, deck (planks or slab), ladder, end posts.
Railing/fence along a straight or arc path: posts, rails, infill (bars, glass panels, pickets).
Standalone roof (closed solid): gable, hip, shed, flat, dome, cone.

Interior room shell (one-sided): rect/rounded/round/oval plan, coves, flat/dome/gable ceiling, shaped door/window openings, optional ring-tessellated floor/ceiling and luminous ceiling panel; meta lists openings (with module placement) + walkable outline.

cap_center.description: close ringed floor/ceiling caps with a centre vertex (radial light falloff) instead of one n-gon fan, whose long thin triangles show as stair-stepped wedges

ceiling_panel.description: luminous ceiling panel (role 'light', chrome 'trim' bezel) at this fraction of the ceiling outline; dome: lit oculus

floor_rings.description: concentric floor/ceiling rings (vertex density for per-vertex light); 0 = single polygon

ring_bias.description: ring spacing exponent: >1 packs rings toward the outline (narrow baked-AO band at the wall base instead of a wide Gouraud zigzag)

kits.description: Stairs: straight (solid blocks or open treads + stringers) or spiral around a column; railings.

Tall landmark tower (closed solids): tapered round body with bold bands, gallery ring + rail posts, glazed lit lantern room, cone/dome cap, lit slit windows, door. Reads from 60 m: lighthouse, observatory, beacon.

gallery.description: railed walkway ring below the top

kits.description: Straight wall segment (closed solid) with optional shaped door notch or window hole; interior face at y=0.

Window: shaped frame ring (flat or molded lip), glass, mullions, ledge, shutters, view card (kit_card_view behind the glass, facing the room). Geometry starts at the sill; origin at floor level below.

frame_style.description: molded = soft rounded lip swept around the opening (additive 3.1)

kits.description: Bed: box/nook/pod/cot frame, mattress, pillows, draped blanket, headboard.
Curled blob bench: one sculpted slab sweeping from a rounded seat end up into a breaking-wave curl; tube legs, draped throw, sphere and small disc table inside the curl.

curl.description: how far the back curls over the seat

kits.description: Seat: stool, chair, armchair or bench; four legs, pedestal or sled base; optional cushion.

Console: smooth mushroom pod (glowing screen ring + top panels, joystick ledge), blobby kidney desk with a rippled rolled rim carrying 1-3 rounded CRT monitors on tube legs, terminal, lectern. Screens use role 'screen' (emissive).

wavy.description: desk: how strongly the molded rim ripples

kits.description: Container: crate, barrel, chest (hinged kit_lid), basket, locker, capsule.
Heat source: stone fireplace, stove with pipe, brazier, molded heater (emissive 'fire').

Lamp: floor/table/hanging/lantern/sphere; shade cone/sphere/drum/dome (emissive role 'light'). height = overall height (floor/table/sphere/lantern) or cord drop (hanging); base applies to floor/table/sphere, shade to floor/table/hanging.

Molded seating: glossy bowl pod with a front-lowered rim and quilted back lobes, chaise tub of quilted lobes with lens portholes and trumpet pedestal feet (+ visor), egg chair with a scooped opening, round conversation pit with throws, pillows and an optional disc table with a sphere. Shell resolution adapts to the detail requested so the 400-tri budget holds (rule rejects what cannot fit).

canopy.description: chaise: glass visor egg on a curved stem

portholes.description: round lens portholes set into the shell

table.description: lounge_pit: low disc table in the centre

kits.description: Rug: thin slab, rect/round/oval, optional fringe.
Bookshelf, cabinet (doors) or open rack; seeded book groups.
Table: rect/round/oval/flower/kidney top; four legs, pedestal, trestle, tulip or solid plinth base; optional ornament.

Particle card (kit_card_particle, role 'particle', alpha-tested pack texture) whose planar outline follows `shape` (flake star, spark sliver, puff cloud, leaf almond, disc octagon) + emitter spec in meta (runtime instancing; rate, lifetime, velocity, spread, gravity and area only act at runtime).
Bush/shrub of overlapping blobs; optional flower heads (role 'flower') and cap (snow/moss).
Grass tuft: solid 3-sided blades (closed pyramids) with optional flower heads.
Rock or cluster: star-shaped noise-displaced spheres (never self-intersecting), sunk into the ground; optional cap.
Tree: broadleaf blobs, stacked conifer tiers, bare branching (cap = snow-laden), birch, palm, crystal (faceted ice trunk, angular branches, glass shards; additive 3.2).
Books: single closed, open (two page blocks), stack (lying) or row (standing, varied heights).
Small device: radio, lantern (glowing core), tablet, clock, beacon, camera; emissive parts use roles light/screen.
Key: classic (ring bow, teeth), skeleton (ornate bow), keycard, crystal key. Lies flat (origin on the floor).
Sign: post sign, hanging (bracket + chains as rods), standing A-board, wall plaque (wall_mounted variant), arrow; text = abstract glyph strips.
Hand tool lying on the ground (origin at the grip centre projected to the floor): hammer, wrench, shovel, axe, pick, broom, flashlight, fishing rod.
Vessel by lathe profile: mug, bowl, bottle, jar, vase, pot, kettle, cup; optional handle, lid and contents.
Sky backdrop: inward-facing dome or cylinder (kit_shell_sky, role 'sky', v = elevation 0..1). Origin at the viewer; extends below y=0 by below_horizon*radius.

below_horizon.description: fraction of radius extending below the horizon

radius.description: placement scale (fit inside the camera far plane); invisible from the viewer

kits.description: Blanket: folded stack, rolled log, or spread flat with soft seeded waves (thin closed slab).
Pillow/cushion: puffy square, round, bolster, floor cushion, heart; optional centre tuft button and piping.
Seeded heightfield terrain patch as a closed slab (top surface + skirt + bottom); rest height y=0 at the edges.

depth.description: slab depth below the lowest point

edge_falloff.description: blend heights to 0 at the edges (tiling)

resolution.description: grid cells per side; closed slab = 2r^2 + 12r - 2 tris (13 -> 492 <= 512)

kits.description: Distant silhouette rings around the viewer (inward-facing, role 'vista' near / 'vista_far' beyond; v = 0 at the base .. 1 at the crest so packs paint haze gradients). Painted depth layers between the playfield and the sky.

below.description: fraction of the radius extending below the horizon

height.description: silhouette height as a fraction of the radius

radius.description: placement scale; keep inside the fog/far plane

kits.description: Water (or ice) plane: thin closed slab with gentle seeded waves; material kind 'water' scrolls UVs in the runtime.

Exterior yard (one-sided landscape shell): flat playfield (the room grid) ringed by readable terraces/ledges and an enclosing jagged ridge wall, passes cut where exits are, lighter path strips from exits to the centre, optional ice slabs/ponds with visible thickness. Meta: exits (placement), paths, terrace/ridge levels, walkable outline.

bowl.description: outer rings round off toward an ellipse (organic valley instead of a walled box)

view_gap.description: fraction of ridge height removed at the view gap

view_gap_azimuth.description: azimuth of the fixed camera's view in the kit plane (deg; +x = 0, north/+y = 90; -1 = none): the ridge is lowered there so distant layers show

view_gap_width.description: full angular width of the lowered ridge (deg)

kits.description: Boat: rowboat/canoe/sailboat/skiff (thick U-section lofted hull with seats, oars, mast+sail, cabin) or log raft.

Ground craft: sled (runners), cart (2 wheels + handle), wagon (4 wheels), rover (rounded cab, 4 wheels), hover pod (skirt), saucer (lens hull, black window bands, light ring, optional glass dome, landing legs; wheel_radius/handle/cargo unused, like wheel_radius for sled/hover).
